revisedMode: Default reoptimize with skipProvenOptimal=true; validate remaining route before bound test.
controls: Freeze comparison before any follow-up map generation. Reuse all 30 maps/prior routes acquired under the paired acquisition protocol, no reselection. Run forced and default-guarded policies anew, A* FIFO budget 300, compare baseline original fields to acquired archive.
measurements: Returned path/length/validity, bound proofs versus A* completions, planner calls/expansions per arm, equality to archived BFS distances, budget failures and original-field compatibility. Count fresh rerun costs separately; zero planner work does not mean zero validation work.
attribution: Student selected the denser condition only, not an outcome prediction. Bound rule/code were fixed before generating this cohort. AI supplies protocol, execution/validation and initial analysis.
scope: Previously unseen condition-specific follow-up under a frozen rule. Not reuse of the .19 development cohort; deterministic sampling still does not establish statistical independence or a causal density comparison. Fully known static four-neighbor unit-cost simulation only.
